title: Microsoft struggles to restore service after global outage
excerpt: A global Microsoft outage impacting Outlook and Teams is proving difficult to fix, with servers unexpectedly becoming unavailable.
body_html:
Microsoft is facing difficulties restoring services following a global technology outage that has impacted widely used platforms including Outlook and Teams.

According to the company, the disruption was triggered when servers unexpectedly became unavailable. This issue created significant strain on other connected systems, compounding the technical difficulties.

Technical teams are currently working to address the problem and bring all affected services back online, though full restoration efforts are ongoing.
